name: sms

description.en: Order-status SMS (W-SMS): a customer who ticks the UNTICKED SMS box at checkout (body field `sms: {order_status, wording}`) has the tick filed in the venue's consent image (purpose order_status, channel sms, the sentence's id) and a stamp kept in the outbox image; when the order is CONFIRMED / READY (pickup) / IN_DELIVERY / REJECTED / CANCELLED the venue's object queues one outbox entry; the drain re-asks the consent fold (a STOP filed after the tick wins), checks the venue's daily budget and posts the text to the venue's OWN gateway: by default its Android phone through SMSGate's cloud (POST https://api.sms-gate.app/3rdparty/v1/messages, HTTP Basic with the credentials the app shows), or textbee / Twilio with the owner's own key. The text carries the order number, the venue name, the state and a STOP line, nothing else.
description.uk: SMS про стан замовлення: клієнт, що позначив SMS при оформленні, отримує SMS з Android-телефону закладу (SMSGate, безкоштовно) або через Twilio/textbee з ключем власника; лише номер замовлення, назва закладу і STOP.

producer.what: at_placement(): the box -> the consent act + the stamp (E.164 number, consent key, lang, venue); refused by name before the order exists
owed(): which status owes a text, written into the outbox by hubdo/sms_turn.rs in the same object turn
Rail::send(): config, age, consent re-asked, daily budget, the post, classify; the health record
request(): the SMSGate / textbee / Twilio request; classify(): 2xx|smsgate 409 sent, 400/404/413/422 refused, other retried

consumer.what: smsBody(): the unticked box sends {sms:{order_status:true, wording:<id>}} only when ticked beside a phone
the owner's SMS screen: gateway, key (masked), daily limit, Test, STOP
the venue's phone receives the queued message from the cloud and sends it from its SIM

external: SMSGate (SMS Gateway for Android, Apache-2.0) cloud API; optional textbee API v1, Twilio REST 2010-04-01

secrets: notify.sms.user + notify.sms.secret: the VENUE's own gateway login, set in the owner console (never a platform key)
QA_SMS_TEST_PHONE (an operator's phone that receives the test texts)
QA_SMSGATE_USER + QA_SMSGATE_PASSWORD (the same login, for the probe to read the gateway's own message state)

order_field_schema.description: the `sms` member of the order body; absent unless ticked

gateway_request_schema.description: what the Worker posts to SMSGate (OpenAPI smsgateway.Message, the fields used)

probe: tools/live-proof/probes/feature-sms.mjs: reads the owner card and the public box against these schemas; WITHOUT the venue's gateway configured (and QA_SMS_TEST_PHONE) every delivery step is NEEDS-KEY, never a pass. With it: the Test button must answer ok and the gateway's own record (GET /3rdparty/v1/messages/{message_id}) must reach Sent or Delivered; a TEST order placed with the box ticked to QA_SMS_TEST_PHONE and confirmed must raise health.sent and its message must reach the phone (Sent/Delivered on the gateway); after a STOP for that number the cancellation is NOT sent (health.stopped rises, sent does not).
